claims.claim: The Subterranean Inquisition Chamber is locked against fast travel until the Abductor Virgins are defeated; after the boss, the exit opens onto Mt. Gelmir. The Abductor Virgin post-boss grace therefore gets a conditional exit edge to the Seethewater route.

The Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella post-boss room is reached from Ainsel River Downstream, and the lift/river route leads back through the Ainsel Sluice Gate. The return is conditional on the boss completion state and does not create a new Nokstella connection.
